checks.check: The current best score came from a single model or a few near-identical members.
checks.how: Inspect submission history and ensemble config for number of distinct model families.

checks.check: Blending is manual with few members and weight changes now move the score by <0.001.
checks.how: Read the log of past blend-weight changes and their score deltas.

checks.check: A recent change caused an unexplained score drop or errors.
checks.how: Compare last submissions' scores and diff of code versions.

checks.check: Local validation disagrees with leaderboard or repeated runs give different scores.
checks.how: Re-run an unchanged submission and compare local CV vs leaderboard rankings.

checks.check: The metric is rank- or threshold-based (AUC, QWK, concordance) and predictions are raw continuous values.
Training features are few/simple or raw inputs have untried representations.
checks.how: Inspect feature list and input pipeline.

checks.check: Model hyperparameters/backbone have not been tuned from defaults.
checks.how: Check config against defaults in earlier versions.

checks.check: Existing members are all from the same family/representation.
checks.how: List members' model types, inputs and feature sets.

checks.check: Additional diverse models are not trainable or loadable within the compute budget.
checks.how: Check available checkpoints, GPU memory and runtime limit.

checks.check: Several candidate checkpoints already exist but only some are in the blend.
checks.how: List saved checkpoints vs. those used.

checks.check: Current members are fold or seed copies of one recipe and more are cheap to add.
checks.how: Count folds/seeds in use and available checkpoint files.

checks.check: One member scores far below others standalone or hurts the blend.
checks.how: Compare each member's individual score and ablate it.

checks.check: Gains from the last added same-family member were negligible.
checks.how: Score deltas of the last few additions.

checks.check: The metric depends only on ordering (AUC, rank correlation).
Out-of-fold predictions exist for all members, enough rows to fit a meta-model.
checks.how: Check OOF files and dataset size.

checks.check: Members are cross-validation folds of the same model.
checks.how: Check whether blend items are folds.

checks.check: Members differ widely in individual quality.
Only leaderboard feedback (no OOF) is available.
checks.how: Check whether OOF predictions were saved.

checks.check: A new or changed member was just added and weights are stale.
checks.how: Compare version diffs for member list.

checks.check: Members' standalone scores differ clearly.
Weights are free continuous values and submissions are limited.
checks.how: Count remaining submissions; check number of weights.

checks.check: Equal weighting currently underperforms the best single member.
checks.how: Compare equal blend vs best member score.

checks.check: The backbone has plateaued and a stronger pretrained variant is available.
checks.how: Check available pretrained weights and memory/time to run them.

checks.check: Model is a gradient-boosted tree.
Model is a fine-tuned neural network with default optimisation settings.
The evaluation metric differs from the training loss.
checks.how: Compare loss function with competition metric.

checks.check: Training shows overfitting (train≫val) on limited data.
Multiple input branches exist and one may be redundant or weak.
Raw data has repeated rows per entity or text with little engineering so far.
Feature count is large, sparse, or recent feature additions degraded the score.
Inputs are signals/images converted to model inputs with tunable parameters.
External or additional labelled data exists, or training set contains a different-distribution subset or noisy labels.
checks.how: Task rules on external data; train/test distribution comparison.

checks.check: Input size/resolution or derived channels differ from what the pretrained model was trained on.
Normalisation statistics, filters or text cleaning are applied differently at train and inference.
Higher resolution is affordable memory-wise.
Entities/groups repeat across rows or distribution differs from test.
checks.how: Check ID columns and train/test comparison.

checks.check: Small public score differences (<0.001) drive decisions or repeated runs differ.
CV is already consistent with leaderboard.
checks.how: Correlate CV and LB over past submissions.

checks.check: The model sees images/signals with natural flip or crop symmetry.
Target is ordinal/discrete or metric uses cutpoints while outputs are continuous.
Inference time budget is tight.
Labels take few discrete values and metric needs discrete labels.
Predictions show systematic bias or out-of-range values.
The model/ensemble changed since thresholds were tuned.
Submission fails or scores near random.
Score dropped substantially after a change.
Several changes bundled or iteration budget unclear.
Notebook hits memory/time limits.
Error appeared after swapping a model file, checkpoint, or platform.
Predictions have wrong shape, order or constant values without errors.
checks.how: Inspect output array and row IDs.

checks.check: Several components changed in the failing version.
The culprit is already known.
A previous best version is restorable.
